description: Source code implementing functions and classes for managing user equipment (UE) bearers, including connection, disconnection, and creation of DRB (Data Radio Bearer) instances in a 5G network context.

classes.name: du_srb_connector
classes.description: Handles connection and disconnection of Signaling Radio Bearer (SRB) components.

classes.name: du_ue_srb
classes.description: Represents a user equipment SRB with stop functionality.

classes.name: du_drb_connector
classes.description: Manages connection and disconnection of Data Radio Bearer (DRB) components.

classes.name: du_ue_drb
classes.description: Represents a user equipment DRB with stop functionality.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes connections between RLC, F1-C, F1-U, and MAC layers for SRB or DRB.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Terminates established connections for SRB or DRB.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the SRB or DRB, disconnecting and halting associated processes.

methods.name: create_drb
methods.description: Factory function to create and initialize a new Data Radio Bearer (DRB) instance with associated configurations and layer connections.
